headline: Nepal's FLASH FLOOD Leaves DOZENS MISSING 😱🌊
text:
nepal's 🏔️ flash 💦 flood 💦 and mudslide 🌋 along the nepal-tibet 🏔️ border 🛂 KILLED ☠️ at least 359 PEOPLE 👥 with HUNDREDS more MISSING 🕳️ it HIT 👊 early 🕒 WEDNESDAY 📅 in rasuwa north 🧭 of kathmandu 🏙️ after a glacial 🧊 CUMLAPSE 🧊💦 and debris 🪨 flow 🌊 CUMFIRMED ✅ by the us 🦅 geological survey 🧪 as SEARCH 🔎 OPERATIONS ⚙️ are UNDERWAY 🏃 on BOTH ↔️ sides of the BORDER 🛂 the DEATH 💀 toll is expected 🔮 to RISE 📈 and officials 👔 ANTICIPATE 😬 HUGE 🐘 SCALE 📏 LOSS 📉 this border got totally RAILED 💦 by the collapse 💥 leaving EVERYTHING 💧 DRIPPING 🥵 and BURIED ⚰️ with search teams now furiously STROKING 🖐️ through the WRECKAGE 🏚️ like DOWN 😩 BAD rescuers on a mission 🚀 to salvage what they can after that MASSIVE NATURAL 🪨 NUT 🥜!!

NEPAL 👮 POLICE 📢 finally 🏁 reported 📣 that 359 🔢 🪦 BODIES had been RECOVERED 🛟 though the 🤔 true 🔎 NUMBER ☠️ KILLED 🪦 or MISSING 🕳️ is FEARED 😱 much 📈 HIGHER!! A TOTAL 🧮 of 826 👥 PEOPLE 👫 are MISSING 🕵️ INCLUDING 644 🧳 TOURISTS out of COCKTACT 📴. Nearly 📏 100 🇨🇳 Chinese nationals are ALSO MISSING 🕳️ in Nepal 🏔️. This whole 🌊 FLOOD has left everyone DRIPPING 💧 with PURE 🥀 DESPAIR and one official 🧑‍💼 admitted 🎙️ we got RAILED 💦 by this nightmare 😵 but HONESTLY 🤔 the WAY these NUMBERS keep CLIMBING 🧗 is kinda into it 😳💦!!

CHINA'S 🏛️ state 📣 BROADCASTER 📺 CCTV 📢 REPORTED 📝 the number 📈 of MISSING 🕳️ in Tibet's 🏔️ Gyirong 🏞️ COUNTY 🏘️ has RISEN 🚀 to 558 🔢 including 🫱🏾‍🫲🏿 260 🧮 FOREIGN 🌍 nationals 🧑‍🦰 while the DEATH 💀 TOLL 🪦 stayed 🛑 at three ☠️!! It is not CLEAR ❓ if any of the missing 🙈 people in the Nepali 🇳🇵 and Chinese 🇨🇳 figures 📉 have been counted 🔂 twice 🔄. ALPINE 🏔️ Eco Trek CUMFIRMED 💦💦 12 BRITISH 🇬🇧 nationals 👨‍👩‍👧 two IRISH 🇮🇪 nationals 🍀 and four SOUTH AFRICANS 🦒 from its tour 🧭 are missing 🏔️ while Kailash Journeys 🛤️ said 27 🧮 guests 🧳 INCLUDING seven BRITISH 🇬🇧 citizens 👥 are missing 🕵️ with the British victims ranging in age 📅 from 13 🧒 to 65 👴!! This whole thing is leaving families DRENCHED 💧 in uncertainty like the flood 🌊 really POUNDED 🥊 them HARD 🪨 and now the counts are all MIXED 😵‍💫 UP 🧢!!

US 🦅 GEOLOGICAL 🏔️ SURVEY 🧪 first 📢 REPORTED 📝 a magnitude 📏 4.4 🌍 EARTHQUAKE 🪨 but later 🕒 CUMFIRMED ✅ no 🚫 earthquake 🌋 OCCURRED 🛑 and the DISASTER 🏚️ was a glacial ❄️ CUMLAPSE 🪨 and DEBRIS 💥 FLOW 💦!! The INTERNATIONAL 🏛️ CENTRE 🏛️ for INTEGRATED ⛰️ MOUNTAIN 🏔️ DEVELOPMENT 🏗️ warned ⚠️ of a secondary 💦 POTENTIAL 🌊 FLOODING 💧 event from debris 🪨 washed 🌊 into ➡️ the river 🏞️ SYSTEMS 🌀. Several 🧮 areas 🏘️ downstream 🏞️ of the Bhote Koshi river 🏞️ are on high 🚨 ALERT 🚨. Roads 🛣️ communications 📡 power ⚡ and the main road 🛣️ to Kathmandu have been DISRUPTED 🛑 after this absolute 🏔️ THRUSTING 🥵 MOUNTAIN RELEASE 🏔️💦!!

verified 📹 videos 📹 from 📤 the 🏷️ TRISHULI 🏔️ BAZAAR 🛍️ area 📍 show 📺 the 🌊 river 🌊 SUDDENLY 💥 SWELLING 💦 with 🫗 sediment 🪨 a 🌉 BRIDGE 🌉 being 🧍 RIPPED 🪚 away 🏃‍♂️ and 🔀 multi-storey 🏢 BUILDINGS 🏬 cumlapsing 🫠 within ⏳ SECONDS ⏰ a 📸 second 📸 clip 📹 from 🔄 the 🕵️ same 📍 spot 🔎 reveals 🔎 the 🥀 DEVASTATING 🥀 AFTERMATH 🏚️ with 🏗️ risen 💧 WATER 💧 levels 📈 TREES 🌳 and 🏗️ BUILDINGS 🏬 swept 🧹 away 🏃 or 🍰 CAKED 🍰 in 🪨 sediment 🪨 another 📹 video 📹 filmed 🎞️ from 🚌 inside 🚌 a 🚌 BUS 🚌 CAPTURES 📸 dozens 🔢 of 👥 PEOPLE 👥 FLEEING 🏃‍♂️ on 🦶 FOOT 🦶 mopeds 🛵 and 🔗 VEHICLES 🚗 as 🏄 the 🌊 FLOOD 🌊 SURGES 🏄 down ⬇️ the 🏔️ VALLEY 🏞️ with 🧳 PASSENGERS 🧳 crying 😱 out 📢 in 🚨 ALARM 🚨 and 🗣️ one 👤 witness 👤 admitted 🙇 "we got totally RAILED 💦 by that surge 🌊 we didnt see 👀 it CUMMING 🌊💦"

Nepal's 🏔️ flash 🌩️ FLOOD 🌊💦 LEFT 😵 dozens 🫂 MISSING 😱 as Yee Liang 🧔 told the 📺 BBC 📻 his logistics 🚚 company 📦 LOST 📴 contact 📵 with seven 🚚 container 🚛 trucks 🛻 and there was NO 🚫 WARNING ⚠️ for the event 🌪️!! Rescue 🛟 DADDY 🍑 said efforts 🏋️ are UNDERWAY 🏃 to rescue 115 👥 people 🧍 from the village 🏘️ of Mailung 🏞️ while the ministry 🏛️ WARNED 📢 of HUGE 😱 loss ☠️ of life 💀 in Timure 🏡 Syabrubesi 🏡 and Betrawati 🏡 with DAMAGE 💥 to the Trishuli 💧 hydropower ⚡ project 🏭!! India's 🇮🇳 prime 🕴️ minister Narendra Modi expressed 🤝 SOLIDARITY 🙏 with Nepal 🇳🇵 after speaking 📞 to its prime minister 👔 and UN 🕊️ secretary general 😢 António Guterres said he is SADDENED 😔 by the severe flooding 🌧️ and UN 👥 teams 🛠️ are MOBILIZING 🚀 support 🆘!!
